  "prompt": "Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this garden platform videogame screenshot into a review sample of FULLY VEGETATED TERRAIN WALLS. Change only the foreground terrain material. Preserve exact composition, girl, fairy, distant garden background, fence, wooden platform, framing, stepped platform positions and heights. USER REQUEST: cover the ENTIRE exposed foreground terrain in green vegetation, including all large front-facing walls, vertical step risers, cliff sides, corners, and all terrain down to the bottom image boundary. Replace ALL brown soil, exposed roots, rocks and mineral textures in the foreground terrain mass with one cohesive dense living wall of small green leaves, moss, creeping groundcover and organically interwoven trailing plants. No visible brown earth or rocks remain. This is a continuous vegetated embankment, not separate leaf stickers or hedge caps sitting on rock. Remove the visual distinction between the current oversized bright leaf trim bands and the walls below: use consistent small-to-medium leaf scale across the entire face, natural varied clusters, subtle depth and soft shadows within greenery, an even continuous green cover that wraps around every corner and connects seamlessly to the low plants on top. Retain readable stepped silhouette through subtle lighting and overlapping natural foliage at edges, without horizontal trim stripes, outlines, exposed dirt seams, sharp rectangular texture borders or repeating ornamental leaf patterns. The tallest grass stays at existing top locations, organically growing through the same low green foliage. Keep top walking surfaces in same positions and keep girl's shoes visible, no vegetation covering her body. Color palette natural rich garden greens, sunny yellow-green upper leaves and softer deeper greens below, matched to existing hand-painted storybook art. Some tiny white flowers may remain near top, walls mainly continuous green foliage, no new large flowers or objects. Single edited screenshot, not a collage; no labels or annotations. Extend vegetation fully to bottom boundary of image, absolutely no exposed soil anywhere on foreground walls.",
